name: Cerberus' Dilemma
source:
In this game you play as Cerberus, the infernal hound guarding the door of Hades.

Some souls will try to get out, asking you to let them through the door. Judge them depending on the circumstances whether to grant him the passage or devour them and send them back to where they came from.

There are no right or wrong answers, answer according to your morality.

[From [url=https://chiara-san.itch.io/cerberus-dilemma]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，你将扮演冥界看门犬刻耳柏洛斯，守卫哈迪斯的大门。

有些灵魂会试图逃出去，求你放他们通过大门。你要根据具体情况判断是准许他们通行，还是吞噬他们，把他们送回原处。

没有对错之分，请依照自己的道德准则作答。

[来源：[url=https://chiara-san.itch.io/cerberus-dilemma]Itch.io[/url]]
